procedure.aligned_content: same-frustum 256x144; area-reduce native prediction and measured image directly; use the cropped legacy prediction without resampling
procedure.eligible: per-method finite & labelled; also within-route four-method intersection; aligned panel adds per-method two-route and full eight-path intersections with both labels available
procedure.example: first registered view v01 and MS-ft, aligned 256x144; highlight 20% of the joint eight-path finite labelled domain
procedure.independent_labels: form an error label from each route's own rendered RGB against the same independent measurement; labels can differ between routes
procedure.native_content: all 448x252 native pixels; rows 56 through 199 inclusive from the 256x256 legacy score and prediction
procedure.photometry: use original 896x504 FP32 display-sRGB target measurements; separable area average on pixel edges in float64, then cast to FP32; all input RGB in a reduced footprint must be finite
procedure.pixel_label: mean of three absolute FP32 display-sRGB prediction-minus-reference differences > FP32(0.05)
procedure.quota: per view floor(q * eligible / 100), q=10 or 20; ascending risk then flattened row-major pixel index; summation over the six separate selections
procedure.resources: one four-thread file scoring invocation per route and model over six views; CPU time, wall time and process high-water memory recorded by the installed replay worker
procedure.score_sampling: same-frustum risk, finite/state/reason use one nearest source centre per axis, floor((output_index+0.5)*input_size/output_size); no averaging of categories or scores
procedure.status: descriptive engineering comparison on one previously exposed authored object, six fixed viewpoints

resource_scope: RSS at file completion is the process high-water through validation, model load, decode and file scoring; lifetime also includes HTML and both resident cache modes
